Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: GHS-POP, the JRC's global population grid (R2023A, 1975 to 2030 every five years, 2025 and 2030 projected), as a population source that needs no country: its window over the study area is read from JRC's cloud-optimized copy on AWS by HTTP range, through the GeoTIFF-at-a-URL path, with nothing downloaded first. Said with its licence, both citations and its limits: residential population, weaker where buildings are hard to see, not to be set against GHS-BUILT.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value. 0.7.1: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs checks the Inspector asks no country, and Configure… offers WorldPop for Botswana from the area, or says to set the country on the area; Chromium. 0.7.2: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs chooses Botswana in the dialog, finds the download link, and finds the country kept on the study area; Chromium. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (two countries offered, the one-file limit said, the area's list left as it was). 0.9.0: tests/grid3-catalogue.test.mjs and tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs (GRID3 for Botswana, 11.6 MB; none for Germany). 0.10.0: tests/ghs-pop.browser.mjs (twelve years offered, the 2015 window read by range only, from a stand-in for JRC's server). The file's layout was measured from one 16 KB read of its header, 2026-11-11.
